timing_conditions: Same checkpointed window for both JAX CPU and GPU drivers; CPU affinity0-15, Nice10, BLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR threads1, no competing GPU job. Three warm repeats per fixture. Fresh physical state each call. BinarySystem construction outside all timers. Each driver measures original CPU Observer, preceding hybrid with CPU coverage, and new batched hybrid. Common scientific contract: host three-band normalized observed curves in original phase order; hybrid extra component/timing metadata also included in elapsed cost. Compile/constructor and stage samples reported separately. Sequential order and only three repeats limit small speedup interpretations. constructor_seconds combines construction of new and preceding comparison engines. First-call measurements include diagnostic captures; warm timing calls use diagnostics=False.
